tools.name: airport_delays_now
tools.description: All US airports with an active FAA event right now: ground stops, ground delay programs (average and maximum delay, reason such as weather or volume, end time), general arrival and departure delays with trend, airport closures and deicing, sorted worst first, plus airspace flow programs.

tools.name: airport_status
tools.description: FAA delay status of one US airport, by IATA code (JFK), ICAO code (KJFK), airport name or city (Newark, O'Hare, Denver): any ground stop, ground delay program, arrival or departure delay, closure or deicing with reason, minutes and end time, or a clear statement that the FAA reports no delay there;

tools.name: airport_delays_check_trip
tools.description: Check every airport on an itinerary (origin, connections, destination; 1 to 8 airports) for FAA ground stops, ground delay programs, delays and closures in one call.
